findings.issue: Paragraph 5.3 and the implementation-cost row say agency implementation costs may be charged to existing budgets in the first year, but Section 12 charges the costs of implementing the Act to the Trust Fund; the memo departs from the bill without saying so, which misreads the funding design for the reviewer.
findings.quote: which shall be used exclusively for the payment of Program Subsidies and the costs of implementing this Act

findings.issue: Part VII defers the measure, yet 5.2, 5.3 and the continuing-funding row set out how the program would be budgeted in the succeeding GAA and in agencies' existing budgets, reading as conditional acceptance; the funding paragraphs should be framed consistently with deferral.
Section 9 excludes current 4Ps households from the subsidy, so the poorest minimum wage families may be left out while better-off ones qualify; this distribution issue is not raised in any part.
findings.quote: shall exclude from the list of Qualified Families any household that is a current 4Ps beneficiary

findings.issue: The registry is built from payroll, SSS and BIR records, while informal workers must apply and be verified, which favours formal-sector earners; the output does not assess this exclusion risk or the cost of verification at city and municipal offices.
findings.quote: Self-employed and informal sector workers earning at or below the applicable regional minimum 7 wage may apply for inclusion through their city or municipal social welfare and development office, subject to verification

findings.issue: Part VI recommends folding the DOLE registry into the DSWD database without addressing the privacy implications of pooling payroll, SSS and BIR records with welfare registries.
findings.quote: based on payroll, SSS contribution, and other employment records, subject to Republic Act No. 10173

findings.issue: Section 10 applies the same fine and up to six years' imprisonment to a beneficiary's misrepresentation, a merchant surcharge and diversion by a public official; proportionality and due process in penalties are not analysed, only referred to LS.
findings.quote: (d) Imposition by any merchant of a surcharge or price differential on subsidy transactions.

findings.issue: The SSS supplies registry data under Section 9 and the coverage table lists BMB-C for the SSS and BSP, but BMB-C is not referred.
findings.quote: in coordination with the Social Security System (SSS), the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR), and employers

findings.issue: The undefined Joint Congressional Oversight Committee raised in Part IV (4.5) is missing from the issues listed in Part VII.
Part VI states the signing date of RA No. 12231, which is not in the material supplied; it should be verified before release.
